handoff_rule_zh: 整条完整流一次性交给对侧主机验证，不分拆逐任务验证。
handoff_rule_en: The complete flow will be submitted once to the opposite host, not validated through separate per-task handoffs.
implementation_order_override: User authorized local full-line development on an isolated candidate; historical acceptance and canonical taskbook claims unchanged.
